scriptural_facts.text: Ammon became a servant to king Lamoni and watched the king's flocks.
Ammon fought with a sling and a sword.

visual_design_choices: A Nephite man in his early thirties, lean and strong from years of travel.
Warm brown skin, dark hair tied back at the neck, short dark beard, steady dark eyes.
Plain undyed cotton tunic belted with a woven sash, a deep blue shoulder mantle, sturdy sandals.
Carries a sling looped at his belt and a sword in a simple sheath.
locked_traits: Same face, beard, hair, and blue mantle in every panel.
Dressed as a servant, not royalty: no crown, jewelry, or rich embroidery.

scriptural_facts.text: Lamoni was the king over the land of Ishmael and a descendant of Ishmael.

visual_design_choices: A Lamanite king in his forties, broad-shouldered, commanding bearing.
Deep brown skin, long black hair, clean-shaven, strong brow.
Crimson and gold woven cape over a white cotton tunic, a jade and turquoise collar, and a feathered headdress with turquoise accents.
Mesoamerican-inspired royal dress; nothing European or Asian.
locked_traits: Same face, headdress, and crimson-and-gold cape in every panel.
Always reads as the king: the most richly dressed person present.
